column1: This database contains the groundwater level data from 2017-2025
The database is prepared yearwise, in which the monthly groundwater level data is entered for each site
This database also has a RP to GS value which is subtracted from the observed value to get the true depth to water table
This dataset also tracks any changes in the RP to GS values.
Finally, after subtracting the RP to GS value, a merged sheet is prepred which contains the monthly data for all the sites and all the years
This dataset is also semiautomated similar to the precipitation one.
